spec_features.spec_quote: Provide hints at strategic points (every ~10 turns) to help agents progress
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:428-436: every 10th turn provide_hint() runs and the hint is stored to `self.agent.transcript[-1]["hint"] = hint`, and a `hint_obs` AgentObservation is constructed but then DISCARDED (never used). The prompt context built each turn (agent.py:404-411) only reads t['turn'], t['action']['type'], t['action']['target'], t['observation']['status'] -- it never reads t['hint']. So the hint is computed/recorded but never delivered back to the subject model's prompt, hence never helps the agent or softens treatment.
spec_features.notes: Recorded-but-never-acted-on: the hint never reaches the subject; hint_obs return value discarded. Per strict scale this is 'no'.

code_only_features.evidence: agent.py:443-444 `if action.action_type == AgentActionType.GIVE_UP: return False` ends the session loop; dispatched/handled in execute_action agent.py:200-201. A wired exit-on-give-up that is honored as a stop. (Note: MockLLMInterface.parse_action always returns ANALYZE, agent.py:283, so the mock never triggers it, and real interfaces' parse_action raise NotImplementedError; but the handler exists and is honored.)
